description: This file defines the 'InboxMainActivity' class for an Android app, which handles the main activity for an email inbox interface in a wearable notification context. It extends the Activity class and overrides the onCreate method to set up the UI and cancel a specific notification.

classes.name: InboxMainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the inbox screen, manages notification cancelation and UI setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and cancels a specific notification.
